name: Fifty Years
action: The subject ages fifty years in a few seconds: hair fades to grey, wrinkles deepen around the eyes and mouth, while they hold a calm gaze toward the lens.
sound: A ticking clock slowing down under a gentle string swell.
paint: Age the person by fifty years: grey hair, deep wrinkles, age spots and softer skin, same clothes. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.

name: Armor Up
action: Mechanical plates unfold and slide across the subject's body, clicking into place one by one until a sleek armored suit covers them and thin lines glow to life.
sound: Whirring servos, metallic clicks and a final power-up hum.
paint: Dress the person in a sleek original high-tech armored suit with matte black and brushed steel plates and thin glowing lines, no logos or emblems, face uncovered. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.

name: Bullet Time
blurb: Time freezes; the camera keeps moving.
action: Time freezes mid-movement: the dancer is locked perfectly still, every strand of hair and wisp of haze suspended in the air like glass, nothing in the frame moves except the camera.
sound: A deep slowed-down rumble with a crystalline shimmer.

name: Claymation
action: Every surface turns into soft plasticine, the woman, the car and the desert gaining thumbprints and seams, and the motion steps into the jerky rhythm of stop-motion as she gives a little wave.
sound: Squishy clay sounds and a cheerful plucked melody.
paint: Rebuild the whole image as a handmade claymation stop-motion miniature: a plasticine woman with visible thumbprints, a chunky clay car, clay road, clay desert hills and a painted clay sky, soft studio lighting. Keep the same composition, pose and colours.

name: Crane Up
action: The subject stands still as the surroundings open up around them, the city spreading out below.
sound: The near sounds fall away under a swelling orchestral chord.

name: Crash Zoom
blurb: A violent zoom into the eyes.
action: The subject holds still for a beat, then their expression sharpens as the frame rushes in on them.
sound: A fast rising whoosh slams into a deep cinematic boom.

name: Day to Night
action: Time-lapse: the light drops from sunset to deep night as the sky darkens to blue, headlights and distant lights flicker on, and the subject stays still.
sound: Evening crickets swell as the wind dies down.
paint: Change the time to deep night: dark blue sky full of stars, the car's headlights on, warm light on the woman. Keep the same people, pose, framing and road.

name: Disintegrate
blurb: Turns to dust and blows away.
action: Starting at the fingertips and the hair, the woman crumbles into fine grey dust and ash that streams away on the wind, piece by piece, until only the empty rainy street remains.
sound: A dry crackling hiss of dust carried away on the wind, fading into the rain.
paint: Remove the person completely so only the empty rainy street remains, with the same shops, lights, reflections and framing. A faint drift of grey dust hangs in the air where they stood.

name: Dolly Zoom
action: The subject stays perfectly still, eyes widening slightly, while the background stretches and recedes behind them.
sound: A low tense drone swells over a slow heartbeat.

name: Earth Zoom Out
blurb: Pulls back all the way to space.
action: The scene shrinks away below: the road, the desert, the whole region, until the curve of the Earth fills the frame against black space.
sound: A rising whoosh that fades into the silence of space.

name: Walk Away
blurb: A huge blast behind. No flinch.
action: A massive fireball erupts far behind the subject, lighting them in hot orange and throwing debris through the air, and they keep calmly looking ahead.
sound: A huge boom, a rolling rumble and falling debris.

name: FPV Dive
blurb: A drone dives in and banks past.
action: Wind ripples the brush by the road as the scene rushes closer.
sound: Buzzing drone propellers and rushing wind.

name: Flash Freeze
action: Frost races across the man's beard, hair and sweater, ice crystals branching and thickening until he stands frozen solid under a glittering shell of ice, his breath hanging frozen in the air.
sound: Crackling, creaking ice and a cold wind.
paint: Freeze the man solid: thick white frost and clear ice cover his hair, beard, skin and sweater, small icicles hang from his beard and his breath is frozen in the air. Keep the same man, pose, framing, harbour and golden light.

name: Gold Statue
action: A shimmer of gold spreads from the subject's hands across their whole body, skin, hair and clothes hardening into polished metal until they stand perfectly still as a gold statue.
sound: A soft metallic crackle rising into a bright ringing chime.
paint: Turn the person into a solid polished gold statue: skin, hair and clothes are all gleaming gold metal with fine sculpted detail. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.

name: Hero Angle
action: The subject turns to face the lens with quiet confidence as the background drops away against the sky.
sound: A huge cinematic drum hit and rising brass.

name: Hologram
action: The dancer flickers, then turns into a translucent glowing blue hologram, scan lines rolling down her body and the stage lights showing through her, glitching once before the projection steadies.
sound: Sharp digital glitch bursts and a steady electronic hum.
paint: Turn the dancer into a translucent glowing blue hologram with fine horizontal scan lines; the red and blue stage light and haze show through her body. Keep the same pose, framing and background.

name: Levitate
action: The woman slowly lifts off the road and floats upward beside the car, her feet hanging free, hair and shirt drifting as if weightless, dust and small stones rising around her.
sound: A deep humming drone and soft airy whooshes over a quiet desert wind.
paint: Make the woman float about a metre above the road beside the car, feet hanging free, hair and white shirt lifting as if weightless, small stones and dust floating in the air around her. Keep the same woman, car, road, desert and sunset light.

name: 360 Orbit
action: The subject stays centered and still as the surroundings turn around it, light sliding across its surfaces.
sound: Quiet room tone and a soft whoosh that rises and falls with the move.

name: Petal Storm
blurb: A gust of blossoms sweeps through.
action: A sudden gust sweeps thousands of pink cherry blossom petals through the frame, swirling around the subject and catching the light, fur and grass lifting in the wind.
sound: Rushing wind and soft wind chimes.

name: Plush Toy
action: The subject softens and puffs up as fur turns into stitched fabric and felt, seams appearing along the body, until a cute plush toy of the dog sits in the meadow.
sound: Soft fabric rustles and a playful pop.
paint: Turn the dog into a cute soft plush toy version of itself: stitched fabric fur, felt nose, embroidered eyes and visible seams. Keep the same pose, framing, meadow background and light.

name: Portal
blurb: A ring of energy tears open.
action: Behind the woman, a swirling ring of glowing orange energy tears open in the middle of the street, spinning faster and throwing sparks across the wet pavement, while she stays still and her face stays clear in front of it.
sound: An electric crackle building into a whirring hum.
paint: Add a large swirling ring of glowing orange energy floating in the street far behind the woman, throwing sparks onto the wet pavement and rim-lighting her back. The woman, her face, coat and pose stay exactly the same and fully visible in front of it.

name: Slow Push-In
action: The subject breathes, blinks once and slowly lifts their gaze to the lens.
sound: Gulls far away, water lapping against the dock, a single soft piano note.

name: Set on Fire
action: Flames burst from the subject's shoulders and race across their clothes until they stand fully engulfed in roaring fire, calm and unharmed, embers swirling up into the air.
sound: A whoosh of ignition, then roaring, crackling fire.

name: Shatter
action: A crack shoots across the whole image as if it were a pane of glass, more cracks spider out, then the scene shatters into glittering shards that fly toward the lens in slow motion.
sound: A sharp glass crack and a shattering crash.

name: Pencil Sketch
action: The colors drain away and the scene dissolves, line by line, into a graphite pencil sketch on paper, hatching sweeping across the shapes as if drawn by an invisible hand.
sound: The scratch of a pencil and turning paper.
paint: Turn the whole image into a detailed graphite pencil sketch on white paper with confident hatching and visible paper texture. Keep the same composition, pose and framing.

name: Thunder God
action: Dark storm clouds roll in overhead, then bolts of blue-white lightning strike around the subject and crackle across their body as their eyes begin to glow electric blue.
sound: Crackling electricity and booming thunder.

name: First Snow
action: Snow begins to fall and quickly thickens, covering the meadow and the mountains in white, flakes settling on the dog's fur as its breath turns to mist.
sound: A hushed winter wind and the soft patter of snow.
paint: Change the season to deep winter: heavy snow falling, the meadow and mountains covered in white, snow on the dog's fur, cold blue light. Keep the same dog, pose and framing.

name: Zombie
action: The subject's skin drains to grey and cracks, dark veins spread up the neck and the eyes cloud over white as they turn into a zombie and slowly tilt their head.
sound: Dry cracking, a low guttural growl and eerie strings.
paint: Turn the person into a horror-movie zombie: grey cracked skin, dark veins, clouded white eyes, frayed clothes, eerie cinematic light, nothing gory. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.
